opportunities.name: Sub Thirty Strikes
opportunities.objective: Compare W packets at 31% and 29% with Dusk ready/unready.
opportunities.mechanic: W attacks add AP missing-health magic only below 30%. E grants attack access; Nashor/Dusk add personal on-hits and Shadowflame has a broader below-40% threshold. P speed enables withdrawal but retains its four-second same-target lock.
opportunities.requiredState: Target below 30% with safe E access.
opportunities.failure: Cannot reach threshold or dies while adding attacks.
opportunities.test: Compare W packets at 31% and 29% with Dusk ready/unready; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits do not prove duplicate P stacks.

opportunities.name: Four Second Return
opportunities.objective: Compare healing under different recent-damage timings.
opportunities.mechanic: R heals from AP and health lost in the previous four seconds and returns to a historical position. W AP shield can delay retreat; Riftmaker supports prolonged combat while Cosmic guides the path to an offensive return.
opportunities.requiredState: Record recent health loss and four-second position.
opportunities.failure: Dies before R or returns outside useful range.
opportunities.test: Compare healing under different recent-damage timings; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Lifetime damage does not count as recent-four-second loss.

ruledOut.reason: P has a four-second lock on each enemy.

unknowns: W/P on-hit repetition and historical healing bookkeeping need live logs.

testPlan: Required state: Target below 30% with safe E access.
Compare W packets at 31% and 29% with Dusk ready/unready; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Cannot reach threshold or dies while adding attacks.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits do not prove duplicate P stacks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
